new_claims: Augmenting each assignment matrix by horizontal Vandermonde feature blocks q_j(b)A(b) preserves honest rank one.

Every nonzero augmented source matrix of rank at most R has a nonzero block that lies in the original Hair-Sahai source space and therefore yields an ORIGINAL satisfying witness via the existing extractor.
On any false instance, augmented admissibility with m injective Vandermonde features forces every nonzero coefficient representation to have Hamming support at least m+1.
Choosing m at least the support size excludes the explicit sparse finite-difference and bounded recombination families from Runs 82-83.
The augmented partial-assignment span remains polynomially updateable because theta(b) shifts affinely and its power vector transforms by a fixed triangular binomial map.
The direct explicit representation is too large for the project's practical stopping condition at representative N.
